text:
Ayana: quick notes from today's microcanary: ran speculative decoding + q8 bring-up for draft-33b on a 2k-prompt eval. big throughput win but some quality regressions.
Raj: numbers? p50/p95 and tokens/sec?
Ayana: p50 down 72ms -> 48ms, p95 220ms -> 150ms. tokens/sec (batch=50) ~1200 -> ~2600. end-to-end latency for short prompts improved ~1.6-2x.
Mika: nice perf. what were the spec params?
Ayana: spec params: beta=0.25, branch_limit=16, warm_prefetch=4 tokens, fallback policy = compare top1 with reference model every 8 tokens. entropy_floor=0.6 applied to speculative proposals.
Lee: how was q8 applied? whole-model or selective?
Ayana: per-layer dynamic q8: per-channel scale + clip, attention weights fine-tuned quant-aware for a few steps. not a naive static cast.
Sophia: and quality regressions — which evals flagged issues?
Ayana: internal benchmarks: TruthQA top1 -0.7% absolute, MATH-style synthetic prompts had higher error rate for arithmetic, and KB fact recall saw a small hallucination uptick (~+1.2% incorrect assertions).
Raj: curious if divergence is sampling-induced. did you run reference beam or greedy baseline?
Ayana: ran greedy+ref-model baseline. the hypothesis: quantization increases softmax noise which, when combined with speculative branch merging, amplifies low-prob tails. we saw token-level KL between ref and q8+spec rise ~0.35 nats on average for first 12 tokens.
Mika: hardware-dependent?
Ayana: yes — we ran both A100 and H100. regressions larger on A100 kernels. H100 had smaller numeric drift. suspect fp emulation and kernel rounding differences.
Lee: action items: 1) log token-level KL and prefix-perp per device, 2) run micro A/B where only q8 toggles (no spec) to isolate, 3) try spec beta sweep [0.1,0.2,0.35] and branch_limit 8/12/16, 4) try entropy_floor 0.4/0.6/0.8.
Ayana: adding: run a tiny calibration fine-tune with quant-aware noise for 500 steps on 50k prompts to see if hallucinations drop. also try a stricter fallback check (compare top3 overlap instead of top1).
Sophia: can we reproduce on Dedicated infra? if it's kernel rounding, customers will see it. schedule a run on dedicated-pool-2 (A100) and dedicated-pool-7 (H100).
Ayana: already queued dedicated runs. small sample command we used: ```
runtest --model draft-33b-q8 --spec beta=0.25 --branch_limit 16 --fallback compare_top1 --evalset internal/2k 
```
Raj: please attach the eval shard with examples where ref wins and q8+spec loses. that will help triage whether it's semantic vs numeric.
Ayana: will upload diffs + a short csv with per-prompt KL, p_ref, p_spec, device, kernel_version. also adding a short log snippet: ```
[run] model=draft-33b-q8 device=A100 tokens/sec=2587 p50=48ms p95=150ms quality_drop=0.7pct
[warn] increased hallucination on KB queries: sample id=1182 diff_reason=token_shift
```
Mika: thumbs up. one more thought — try merging speculative outputs via normalized logit averaging instead of argmax merge; might reduce rare-token amplification.
Lee: put the follow-ups in a tiny checklist in the doc and let's reconvene after dedicated runs.
dev-bot: canary deploy completed at 11:23 PT (run id 2026-03-20-11-23-07).
Ayana: thanks — will share results from dedicated pools later today.
